## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her humorous and charming experiences as a schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny classroom anecdotes, excerpts from her students' compositions, and the story of how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied an old love letter for her assignment. Finally, she highlights a letter from her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), about his imaginative rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) to ask if she can live with them at Patty's Place, and they agree subject to consulting [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) shares her relaxed views on chaperone duties and introduces her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat, to Patty's Place. [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) tries to fight both newcomers, getting put in his place by the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat and engaging in repeated battles with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) before becoming his close friend. The girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat comfortably together about their household routine and pet antics.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) chat about the snowy weather and rising prices. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then reads aloud a humorous letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), who reports on local news from home including Mrs. Lynde's misadventures, his school essay, and various neighborhood gossip.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place before deciding to take a walk in the park. Catch in a sudden rainstorm, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets a handsome fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student named Royal Gardner, who rescues her with his umbrella and walks her home. Later that evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> [Janet](../character/janet.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where they meet [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who walks [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, John invites [Janet](../character/janet.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to his house for tea to meet his mother, who acts excessively sweet and fragile while subtly making [Janet](../character/janet.md) uncomfortable. [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices John's pained expression during the visit and wonders about the true dynamic in his household as they return to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chatter with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations, Phil's engagement, and Aunt Jamesina's past suitors. Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cure a rainy-day bout of melancholy by reading over old, melodramatic stories written by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club), inspiring [Anne](../character/anne.md) to rewrite one of her old sketches.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s
